proposed_from.topic: Complete removable-root calibration frontier for paired Gaussian LiMVAMs. For finite p variables and m views, observe every within-view covariance but paired cross-view blocks only inside a calibration subset S; views share an unknown topological order, view-specific coefficients, and independent-across-variable Gaussian disturbance vectors with positive-definite cross-view covariances. Prove that an order is compatible iff its order-constrained modified-Cholesky residual cross-blocks are diagonal, and that a removable-root recursion is necessary and sufficient with Schur-complement state indexed only by the removed variable set. Build a memoized 2^p-state plus output-size algorithm returning all distinct full-view coefficient tuples, positive-definite noise certificates, the essential ancestral poset, and a minimum-cardinality S identifying the full tuple. Add finite-sample operator-norm covariance-region inversion, Hausdorff coefficient-set consistency off feasibility boundaries, and exact poset recovery under fixed score and path-product margins. Apply it to Heurtebise et al.'s Cam-CAN MEG and fMRI PairwiseLiMVAM/DirectLiMVAM workflow, using a certified participant calibration subset for order while retaining every participant marginal for coefficients. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolver derived that each fixed order uniquely determines every view's modified-Cholesky residualizer and is compatible exactly when all selected residual cross-covariance blocks are diagonal. Those diagonal blocks are positive definite and extend to unselected views by zero cross-disturbance completion. Sequential root removal equals projection onto the span of removed variables, so its Schur complement depends only on that set; root cross-orthogonality plus recursive feasibility is necessary and sufficient. Exact p=2 calculations gave reverse compatibility iff the two disturbance correlations agree. Exact p=m=3 enumeration matched the subset DP for all six orders and seven nonempty calibration subsets; a chain with selected correlations 1/5, 2/5, and 3/5 was identified by S={1,2}, while view 3 was recovered from its marginal. Checks covered equal-correlation ambiguity, unequal-correlation rejection, zero-edge duplicate orders, residual positivity, unobserved-block completion, consumer organization, and current-literature collisions. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove output-sensitive quotient enumeration that emits every distinct full-view coefficient tuple once from the 2^p-state order DAG without factorial traversal when many topological orders induce the same tuple. EARLY KILL TEST: Re-run exact-arithmetic p=m=3 exhaustive order/subset enumeration against DP leaves and require both leaf-set equality and a proper-subset unique-tuple witness; any mismatch stops the run.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The headline is the generic two-view theorem, not the fixed-order residual iff. For each wrong order, clearing positive principal-minor denominators gives an explicit polynomial, and a one-edge unequal-correlation parameter makes that polynomial nonzero. The finite product therefore defines a proper Lebesgue-null exceptional set, outside which any preassigned view pair yields the true order, the same singleton coefficient tuple as full calibration, and minimum admissible calibration size two. Heurtebise et al.'s Section 4.6, Assumption 2 and Theorem 3 instead use full pairing and edgewise diversity on a broader class; the comparison is restricted-domain and addresses a different observation regime. The equality witness \(P_{\mathrm{ex}}\) lies on the pair-specific exceptional set and shows that genericity cannot be replaced by an everywhere claim. Fixed-order completion and residual-witness hitting are supporting consequences. Removed-set path independence, complete compatible-order paths, explicit inference moduli, and the open output-sensitive quotient problem retain the original complete-frontier infrastructure.

seed_details.one_line: A complete partial-calibration LiMVAM equivalence theorem: an order is compatible if and only if every observed order-residual cross-block is diagonal, with a path-independent removed-set recursion.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize the entire observational-equivalence class when all marginal covariances but only the cross-blocks inside a strict view subset are observed.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the full-pair root-identification step in Heurtebise et al. by an orderwise modified-Cholesky residual criterion, then prove that sequential projection depends only on the removed set.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for partial-pairing LiMVAM, calibration-subset Gaussian LiMVAM, and modified-Cholesky residual cross-covariance equivalence found no theorem beyond the full-pair anchor.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate from HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM because deleting unused view pairs merely weakens its score.
seed_details.rebuttal: The anchor proves uniqueness under a diversity condition; it neither gives the necessity direction for every candidate order nor a positive-definite completion and exact equivalence set after cross-block deletion.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is structure identification, so M18 is the native shape; M6 records the genuinely new necessity-and-sufficiency frontier rather than recasting an effect-identification argument.
seed_details.burned_reason: The sole proposal angle exhausted bounded graph-completion and inference repairs; the remaining exact-once quotient oracle is not derivable noncircularly from the removed-set DAG.

seed_details.one_line: An output-sensitive quotient traversal of the removed-set order DAG that emits each distinct full-view coefficient tuple once.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Avoid factorial traversal when zero coefficients and commuting removable roots make many compatible orders induce one numerical tuple.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace graphical orientation signatures by a canonical full-view modified-Cholesky tuple signature and prove either local compositionality or a reachable quotient parent with generatable children.
seed_details.destination_search: The closest general result requires a decomposable colored AND--OR graph and a locally defined equivalence; no source establishes that global numerical LiMVAM tuple equality satisfies that congruence.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate from WangEtAl2023EquivalenceEnumeration because the removed-set DAG is already an acyclic AND--OR graph.
seed_details.rebuttal: The state DAG is acyclic, but equality of completed regression tuples is global and can merge paths only after later zero coefficients are exposed; the required local color congruence and child oracle are precisely unproved.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The open node carries a concrete colored-AND--OR or reverse-search handle without precommitting a quotient construction.
seed_details.status: survived and chosen as the first-class open question

seed_details.one_line: A minimum-cardinality passive calibration design characterized by residual-witness hitting, including equality-stratum collapse.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Choose the smallest set of views that must remain jointly paired so that every view-specific coefficient matrix is as identified as under full pairing.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Associate each coefficient-new order with the view pairs whose residual off-diagonals refute it, then prove that induced view pairs hit every such witness family exactly when the full-calibration tuple set is preserved.
seed_details.destination_search: Intervention-design searches recover graph-separation and set-cover results, but no passive numerical witness theorem for shared-order multi-view covariances.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate set cover after computing all incompatible orders.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nontrivial theorem is the equivalence between tuple preservation and hitting only coefficient-new orders; orders that are graph-distinct but tuple-duplicate must be quotiented before the witness family is correct.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The structural tuple remains the target, so M18 is primary; M6 records the exact certificate and failure direction rather than misclassifying passive calibration as a randomized experiment.

proposed_from.literature_map: HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM is the model and writing anchor: its shared-order Gaussian LiMVAM uses all paired-view cross-covariances, proves identification under cross-view diversity, and recursively residualizes a discovered root, but it does not characterize the coefficient set after only a strict calibration subset remains paired. HyttinenEberhardtHoyer2012Overlapping gives an if-and-only-if pair condition for identifying linear models from overlapping experiments, but its observables are experimental total effects rather than paired-view disturbance correlations. GuoPerkovic2021MinimalEffects partitions a Markov equivalence class into subclasses with distinct total-effect functionals, while WienobstEtAl2023MECEnumeration gives linear-delay enumeration of graph-distinct DAGs; neither quotients covariance-dependent order paths by equality of all numerical coefficient matrices. WangEtAl2023EquivalenceEnumeration is the closest newly located algorithmic thread: colored decomposable AND--OR graphs admit polynomial-delay enumeration of locally defined equivalence classes, so the first new step is to establish a locally compositional signature for LiMVAM tuple equality or to replace that hypothesis by a quotient reverse-search parent. HauserBuhlmann2014ActiveLearning and LindgrenEtAl2018CostAware reduce interventional identification design to graphical separation systems, but passive calibration has numerical residual witnesses that can vanish on equality strata. GhoshalHonorio2018LinearSEM controls recursive Schur updates and score margins in an identifiable Gaussian SEM, and ChernozhukovHongTamer2007SetInference supplies the contour-inversion logic for a non-singleton target. Exact searches for partial-pairing LiMVAM, calibration-subset LiMVAM, and the target--method pair returned no closer theorem.

banked_proposal_promise_gap: The 2^p removed-set recursion enumerates compatible orders, not distinct coefficient tuples exactly once with output-sensitive complexity; minimum calibration therefore remains exhaustive.
